        'DynamicProxy':{'DP'}
    }

    result = {}
    totals = {}
    f = []

        f.append(row)

        totals[key] = 0

    print("")
    print(f"Sum (out of {total}): {sum} ({100*sum/total})")
    print("-------------------------------------------------------------------")
